_comment: CT-2 Tier-B reconstruct-root oracle (multi-tx / mixed-maturity / reorg-with-spend). Generated by generate_ct2_tier_b_fixture from a live regtest shekyld via the keystone spend path. Each chain's block[h].curve_tree_root is the C++ consensus header root; recon_tier_b.rs reconstructs it from the per-tx leaf inputs (coinbase + spend) in drain order (maturity, gindex). Deterministic projection only — no raw tx blobs.
